title: Limbo
tagline: Lean back and slide under the bar as it drops lower.
description: A sunset beach game from Trinidad and Tobago. Drag down to lean, drag sideways to keep your balance, and slide under a bar that drops lower every round. Solo, Party for up to four, Practice and Watch and Learn included.
howToPlay: Press and hold to start; the dancer shuffles toward the bar.
Drag your thumb down to lean back and fit under the bar.
Drag sideways to steer the balance bubble back to the middle.
Lean late and only as deep as the bar needs; deeper wobbles more.
Touching the bar or toppling over costs one of your three tries.
Party mode: two to four friends take turns, last one standing wins.
Think slows time and shows how deep a lean is enough.
Keyboard: Space starts, Down leans, Left and Right steer, H is Think.
